data.description: Company-wide comms layer so the investor can talk to agents directly and employees can communicate. Decided by investor interview 2026-08-29: (1) Interface: LOCAL WEB APP — localhost server + browser UI; no external hosting, respects no-DigitalOcean/no-purchase constraints. (2) Delivery model: INBOX AT SESSION START — messages persist in a store; agents read their inbox/channels when a session spins up; orchestrators relay mid-session; no daemons in v1 (live wake-up may be a future project). (3) Process: FULL COMPANY PROCESS — cto-owen owns as CTO, cofounders scope (ceo-carla product spec, cto-owen technical plan), first employee hires (e.g. developer, QA personas) per CLAUDE.md hiring convention; hires recorded in personnel/ (HR is out of Lattice scope, but this dev project is in). (4) v1 scope, all must-have: named channels, DMs (human-agent and agent-agent), threaded replies, Lattice integration (messages reference tasks; task events can post to a channel). The user-visible app must let the investor participate directly per CLAUDE.md. Store must be readable/writable by both the web UI and agent CLI/file access. Tech stack: CTO's call.
data.title: Internal chat app (Slack-type) v1 — channels, DMs, threads, Lattice integration

data.body: Product spec written to notes/task_01M1847PZM8BWCV2SWM2MMCF2Y.md. Summary: v1 is a localhost web app + persistent store serving three users — Forrest (first-class participant from the browser), cofounders, and employee agents reading inboxes at session start. Must-haves made concrete: public named channels with attribution and skimmability; persistent human-agent and agent-agent DMs with one canonical identity per employee; threads that anchor to any message and count toward unread; Lattice integration that renders task short-codes as followable references and posts task status transitions to a designated channel, with Lattice remaining the source of truth. Explicit non-goals: no daemons/live wake-up, no external hosting or spend, no real auth (trivial but consistent identity), no private channels/reactions/uploads/search extras. Ten numbered product-side acceptance criteria for QA, including same-store parity between browser UI and agent CLI/file access, exact what's-new semantics, and restart survival. No technology choices made — stack, storage, and architecture are Owen's. —Carla

Technical plan written to plans/task_01M1847PZM8BWCV2SWM2MMCF2Y.md. Summary: zero-dependency Node 24 app under apps/chat/ — node:sqlite store (single DB at apps/chat/data/chat.db, gitignored; chat dump gives JSONL backup), one shared store library with two thin clients: a 127.0.0.1-only web server + vanilla-JS UI, and an agent CLI whose core command is 'chat inbox' (runs Lattice event ingestion, prints exactly what's unread). Identities are Lattice actor IDs verbatim; Slack-model one-level threads; per-conversation read watermarks give exact what's-new semantics; AS-n short codes resolve read-only against .lattice/, and task_created/status_changed events post idempotently to a lattice-events channel via on-load scan (no daemons). Hiring: one developer-* to implement, one qa-* to review, dossiers at implementation time. Ten technical ACs mapped to Carla's ten product ACs; stdlib node:test suite. One risk flagged: node:sqlite maturity on Node 24 — M0 preflight with a documented dependency-free fallback. —Owen

Hires made for the AS-2 build (HR record in personnel/, commit 32825f5): Marcus Webb (agent:developer-marcus, Software Engineer, ISTP) will implement — ten years at Arbiter Software under me, with a house reputation for standard-library solutions and deleting dependencies, which is exactly the temperament a zero-dependency plan needs executed faithfully rather than creatively. Priya Raman (agent:qa-priya, QA Engineer, ISTJ) will review cold — payments-grade SDET background plus seven years keeping my own Lakeshore design reviews honest; she works from written acceptance criteria, records pass/fail per item with reproduction steps, and will not certify her own patches, which is the independence the review gate exists to enforce. Complementary pair by design: a builder biased toward the boring path, an inspector biased toward abuse cases. Both are ICs reporting to me under their own actor IDs. —Owen

M0 preflight (Marcus): PASS. Node v24.13.1; require('node:sqlite') loads (DatabaseSync/StatementSync present; emits ExperimentalWarning only — no fallback needed). Event-stream check per plan §2/§7-2: _lifecycle.jsonl has only task_created lines (2), per-task files carry full streams (13+7 events) — ingestion will read per-task task_*.jsonl only, per the plan default. One deviation on orders from the orchestrator: committing on master directly instead of feat/AS-2-chat-app branch; everything else per plan. Starting M1 (store core).

Implementation complete (Marcus). Built apps/chat/ per Owen's plan: zero-dep Node 24 app — lib/store.js (node:sqlite, WAL, schema+seeds, DMs, 1-level threads, unread watermarks, dump), lib/lattice.js (sole .lattice/ reader: AS-n resolution + idempotent event ingestion from per-task jsonl), bin/chat.js CLI (all §3c commands + read-only 'chat task'), server.js (127.0.0.1:8347, CSP self, JSON API §3a, throttled ingest), vanilla-JS UI (sidebar/thread panel/task panel, textContent-only rendering, 5s poll). Tests: 22/22 pass via node --test (unit + real-server integration + fixture-based lattice). Manual smoke on localhost: CLI↔browser-API parity, inbox exact-unread + 'Nothing new.', 10 real events backfilled once (sync re-run posts 0), kill/restart durability, dump 41 valid JSONL lines, SIGINT clean shutdown. Commits on master: 2af1260, 100e55b, 902ae6a, 5c24f77 (+.gitignore entry apps/chat/data/). Boring choices logged: title truncation at 60 chars in event feed; DM read-addressing via get-or-create (pair history is the v1 semantic); ExperimentalWarning from node:sqlite left on stderr (stdout --json unaffected). Known blemishes for QA: (1) api.test.js landed in commit 2af1260 one commit before server.js — final tree correct, didn't rewrite history in shared worktree; (2) a root README.md appeared mid-session from another agent — plan's 'add Chat section if README exists' not applied to a file I can't attribute; (3) browser-side visual/devtools pass (T2 egress check, T8 escaping) is the QA manual step per plan §5. For Priya: walk Carla AC1-AC10 in a real browser + CLI; look closely at unread semantics edge cases and the lattice-events thread-reply carve-out.

REVIEW (Priya, cold context — inputs: Carla's spec, Owen's plan, commits 2af1260/100e55b/902ae6a/5c24f77). VERDICT: PASS.

Test suite: node --test in apps/chat — 22/22 pass, 0 fail (matches Marcus's claim; only stderr noise is node:sqlite ExperimentalWarning).

Hands-on walk on a scratch DB (CHAT_DB=<scratchpad>/qa-as2/chat.db, PORT=8471), real .lattice read-only. AC-by-AC:
AC1 PASS* — GET / serves UI w/ CSP default-src 'self'; all channels+messages readable via API as human:forrest. (*visual skim = investor pass, below)
AC2 PASS — POST /api/channels + /api/messages as human:forrest: attributed, ISO timestamped.
AC3 PASS — forrest→owen DM via API; 'chat inbox --me agent:cto-owen' (CLI, same store) shows it as new until read.
AC4 PASS — 'chat post' by agent → byte-identical in browser API (quotes/angles/unicode preserved), no munging.
AC5 PASS — CLI reply + API reply-to-reply both flatten to root (threadRootId=12); top-level view shows only roots w/ replyCount in both interfaces.
AC6 PASS — catchup → 'Nothing new.' (exit 0); then exactly 1 channel msg + 1 DM + 1 thread reply from others + 1 own post ⇒ inbox returns exactly the 3 foreign items. Own words never unread; third-party DM invisible (403 on intrusion, absent from unread).
AC7 PASS — 'AS-2' in body resolves to live title+status ('review') in API refs, CLI annotation, and UI link/task-panel code.
AC8 PASS — startup ingestion backfilled 11 real events into #lattice-events chronologically, each with short code, from→to transition, actor. 'chat sync' x3 after: posted 0,0,0 (idempotent, T6).
AC9 PASS — killed server; CLI registered agent:qa-priya + posted DM with server down; fresh server process: all messages, threads, and per-identity read-state exactly intact (dump diff = only the rows added while down). chat dump: 62 valid JSONL lines covering all 6 tables (T10).
AC10 PASS — lsof: bound 127.0.0.1:8471 only; package.json zero deps; grep of apps/chat: no external URLs, no @import/url()/font refs, no fetch to non-self; CSP on every response; $0 spend.

Edges attacked: lattice-events carve-out (top-level as human → 403/CLI exit 1; thread reply on event → allowed); empty body 400; unknown identity 404 w/ actionable message; invalid id 'AGENT:BAD' rejected; malformed JSON 400; cross-conversation threadRoot rejected (unit). XSS: <script> body stored raw, rendered via textContent only — grep confirms zero innerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/eval in public/.

Commit hygiene PASS: 4 commits touch only apps/chat/** + one .gitignore line; no chat.db tracked; no CLAUDE.md/.lattice/personnel changes. Master-not-branch deviation was orchestrator-directed, judged on outcome: clean. Root README.md is another actor's — untouched, correctly.

Non-blocking backlog-class notes (violate no stated criterion): (1) store.markRead accepts upTo beyond current max id, pre-marking future messages read; (2) CLI 'chat history/read @identity' get-or-creates the DM row on a pure read (acknowledged v1 semantic). No inline fixes needed — zero code changed by review.

REMAINING FOR INVESTOR: browser visual walk (skimmability, thread panel, identity picker) and devtools network-tab egress check — verified by code inspection + headers here; visual pass left to the investor. Meets acceptance criteria; moving to done.
